# Verbs: core

The authoring verbs. They are how the Human Lead adds to everything in the Lore that is outside core. These files are core: they are not edited in place, an upgrade of AI-Lore replaces them as a whole, and no other file in the Space may take the name of one of them.

There is no verb for changing or removing a file of the Lore. With the Lore claimed, editing or deleting one of the Space's own files is an ordinary write.

- [verb-add.md](./verb-add.md): use when the Human Lead wants a new action that the AI Agent performs on request in this Space, or the Space's own version of a default verb; it writes one new verb card and its index line in the Lore, and needs Writing with the Lore claimed.
- [process-add.md](./process-add.md): use when the Human Lead wants a new sequence of steps with its gates in this Space, or the Space's own version of a default process; it writes one new process card and its index line in the Lore, and needs Writing with the Lore claimed.
- [contract-add.md](./contract-add.md): use when the Human Lead wants a rule for something that must never happen when a session writes in this Space; it writes one new contract card in the Lore, with a check script where a script can check the rule, and needs Writing with the Lore claimed.
- [corpus-add.md](./corpus-add.md): use when the Human Lead wants the meaning of a word of this Space written down for every session, or the Space's own version of a default corpus entry; it writes one new corpus entry and its index line in the Lore, and needs Writing with the Lore claimed.
- [payload-add.md](./payload-add.md): use when the Human Lead adds a repository or a publish area to this Space; it records the payload in the Space's manifest, clones or creates its folder, and writes its mirror with a first skeleton, and needs Writing with the Lore claimed.
